description: B1 classifier run in epoch-anchor mode with explicit Neutral (no-trade) handling. EMA240 + VWAP only. This is the 86.1% accuracy / 83.7% coverage baseline.

data_spec.anchor_definition: Group by previousEpoch and take the last row by Timestamp as the anchor row.
data_spec.neutrals: Any row where B1_core returns 0 is considered a Neutral / no-trade and excluded from accuracy, but counted in coverage denominator.

classifier.neutral_handling: Pred = 0 means: do not place a bet on this epoch.

metrics.notes: Coverage = fraction of epochs with non-neutral B1_core prediction.

equations.EMA240: EMA_t = alpha * Close_t + (1 - alpha) * EMA_{t-1}, where alpha = 2 / (240 + 1).
equations.VWAP_5m: VWAP_5m(t) = (∑_{i ∈ window_5m(t)} Close_i * Volume_i) / (∑_{i ∈ window_5m(t)} Volume_i).
equations.B1_core_logic: Let e = EMA240_slope(t), v = VWAP_drift(t). Let s_e = sign(e), s_v = sign(v), a_e = |e|. If e is NaN → pred=0. If a_e ≥ θ_strong (0.4) → pred = s_e. Else if s_e ≠ 0 and s_e = s_v → pred = s_e. Else → pred=0.
